body:
WRINGING KELP
CR 3

XP 800
N Medium plant
Init -2, Senses blindsense 60 ft.; Perception -2

DEFENSE

AC 11, touch 8, flat-footed 11 (-2 Dex, +3 natural)
hp 34 (7d8 +7)
Fort +6, Ref +0, Will +2
Damage Immunities cold

OFFENSE

Speed 5 ft.
Melee a wringing kelp may grapple up to two Medium-sized creatures or four small-sized creatures.

STATISTICS

Str 17, Dex 6, Con 13, Int 2, Wis 10, Cha 9
Base Atk +5; CMB +8 (+10 grapple), CMD 16

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Cush (Ex)

At the end of its turn, every creature the Wringing Kelp is grappling suffers 1d6 + 3 bludgeoning damage. One kelp can grapple up to two medium-sized creatures or four small-sized creatures. Creatures grappled by it are at disadvantage to attack rolls.

Strangle (Ex)

When a creature fails to escape a Wringing Kelp’s grapple, reduce the me that creature can hold its breath by 1 additional round.
